about: OxyOS's Settings (apps/settings, sample/SettingsApp.tsx) changing the session's preferences (docs/adr/0019-settings.mdx): granted `settings` as a session grants an administrator's entry, it reads every preference as kept and asks the session for a change, which the session validates, keeps in the preferences file and tells every application. Choosing Dark: the session tells the application it draws dark, and Bloom draws Settings dark at once (React Native's Appearance, no restart); Auto: dark or light from the sun where the system's time zone is; Light: light again; an accent: the session tells it and Bloom's palette follows it (the platform's `appearance` capability), the page tinted and the switch drawn in it; Reduce motion on the Accessibility page: the session tells it and the switch shows it on; on the Notifications page (docs/adr/0026-notifications.mdx), Do Not Disturb on and Show previews: Always, each kept by the session. The file holds the last choices. A preference the session tells back renders the page that shows it, never the window around it (`renders`: the switch's page and Bloom's providers, about 117 components, where the window, its rail and its toolbar were 471; the segmented control's, about 171 where they were 530). From its launch to its first change, every worklet Settings runs on worklets' UI runtime is the framework's, compiled ahead (`worklets`: none compiled from its text; docs/performance.mdx). Without the grant the application keeps its changes to itself and the session is told nothing, so every step fails.

steps.name: Dark: the session keeps it and tells the application, which draws dark at once
An accent colour, by its name (Blue): the session tells every application, and Bloom's palette follows it at once
Accessibility: its page shows the switches as the session keeps them
Reduce motion's switch on: the session keeps it and tells every application
Notifications (ADR 0026): its page shows Do Not Disturb and the lock screen's previews as the session keeps them
Do Not Disturb's switch on: the session keeps it (the shell would show no banner)
Show previews: Always, kept by the session
